title: QR Menu Payment
scenario: A restaurant QR menu opens a payment page before showing prices.

answers.A: Enter card details before seeing the menu or bill.
answers.B: Scan it but stop before entering the card number.
answers.C: Ask staff for the menu and pay through the restaurant verified method.
answers.D: Check the restaurant official payment instructions before scanning.

explanation: A menu should not force payment before you know what you are buying. Confirm the QR destination and payment process with staff.
